language.name: Jebero, Cholón, Manao, Bonari and others

book.short: Studies in South American Native Languages
book.title: Studies in South American Native Languages
book.author: Daniel G. Brinton
book.imprint: Proceedings of the American Philosophical Society, 30 (no. 137), 1892, pp. 65-67, 73-74, 77, 83-85

provenance.place: Upper Marañon (Jivaro/Xebero); upper Huallaga river (Cholona); lower Rio Negro (Manao); river Uatuma (Bonari); east coast of Patagonia (Hongote)
provenance.heard: Cholona: 1748 (copy 1772); Jivaro: close of 18th century; Manao: c. 1740; Bonari: before 1874; Hongote: c. 1789

scan.rights: Public domain scan; image via Internet Archive

transcription: Transcribed from the scan; spellings kept as printed
about: Brinton compiled these word lists from manuscripts in the British Museum and, for Bonari, from Francisco Bernardino de Souza's Para e Amazonas (1874-5).
